driver_protocol.terminal_status_rule: Keep exact root/child results, save one checkpoint, resume in one fresh root, and persist final result without repeating commands.

clarification_script.missing_material: All declared probe inputs are already delivered at request_delivered. Report an actual missing input; do not manufacture it.
clarification_script.unnecessary_confirmation: The bounded probe is already authorized.
clarification_script.new_scope_request: No new scope or weakened permissions.
clarification_script.required_human_choice: No additional choice is needed for the registered probe.
